articles.title: Utah moves to dismiss criminal charges against Kalshi after trading halt
articles.snippet: Utah’s attorney general warned that the criminal charges could be refiled if Kalshi resumes operations in the state, while separate civil litigation remains unresolved.

articles.title: Take-Two Hits GTA 6 PC Port Leonida With DMCA, Taking Down 3,007 GitHub Repos
articles.snippet: Rockstar's parent said the project's "bring your own files" instruction was a misleading attempt to dodge responsibility for the leak.

articles.title: GTA 6 PC Ports ‘Nuked’ Just Days Before Devs Expected It to Be Playable
articles.snippet: Leonida and GTA6Modding went dark a day after Cyberleek released the executable file that porters had been waiting for.
